name: afnm-lucky-all-around
description: Configurable pity-event luck weighting for Ascend From Nine Mountains

afnmWorkshop.title: Lucky All Around
afnmWorkshop.description:
Lucky All Around lets you control the hidden luck multiplier used for Explore pity events.

What this mod does:
- Adds a global setting for pity-event luck from 1x to 10x
- Lets you choose between Force mode and Never Worse mode
- Applies the chosen setting across all saves

Modes:
- Force: every pity event uses exactly the multiplier you choose
- Never Worse: lower vanilla tiers are raised up to your chosen multiplier, but higher vanilla tiers are kept

Example:
- Force 6x makes every pity tier 6x, which can lower native 8x and 10x tiers
- Never Worse 6x behaves like a 6x floor instead

Important notes:
- This changes Explore pity-event weighting only
- It does not rewrite unrelated luck systems
- It changes weighting, not guaranteed outcomes

Open the mod settings from the game's mod loading screen to adjust the mode and multiplier.
